title: Extend Your Haircut's Lifespan: Simple Care Tips for Norwich Clients
description: Simple, practical advice from 3D Cutz on keeping your haircut looking fresh between visits — styling, washing and small upkeep tips for Norwich clients.

content.heading: Pick a style that grows out well
paragraphs: The easiest way to make a cut last is to start with one that suits your routine. When you visit 3D Cutz at 19 Prince of Wales Road, make time to explain how often you can realistically come back and what you do day to day — your barber can shape a cut that keeps its form as it grows.
Shorter, blended styles and gentle tapers usually age better than very sharp edges; ask for a softer line if you prefer longer gaps between visits.

content.heading: Simple washing and styling habits
paragraphs: Avoid overwashing — for many men shampooing every other day or even less keeps natural oils in balance and helps the cut hold its shape. Use a mild shampoo and a conditioner suited to your hair type, and blot dry rather than rubbing vigourously.

Apply products sparingly: a small amount of paste or a light pomade on damp hair will help keep texture without weighing hair down. Work product through with fingers and finish with a comb or brush to maintain the intended silhouette.

content.heading: Quick upkeep you can do at home
paragraphs: Morning maintenance often takes minutes: a quick brush or comb through, a touch of product to tame flyaways and reshaping the part will keep things tidy. Dry shampoo is useful on busy days to absorb oil and add texture between washes.

If you like to tidy the neck line or around the ears between appointments, use a small trimmer with guards and go conservatively — or pop into 3D Cutz for a fast tidy so you don’t lose the cut’s original balance.

content.heading: Protect your hair overnight and after exercise
paragraphs: Sleeping on a clean pillowcase and avoiding heavy friction helps preserve shorter styles; for longer hair a loose bun or soft tie will reduce creasing. Rinsing salt and sweat out after workouts prevents build-up that can make hair look limp or gritty.
If you’re heading out after the gym, a quick rinse, a light conditioning spray or a small amount of product applied to damp hair will refresh the shape without needing a full restyle.
